title: A Little Princess
sourceTitle: A Little Princess / Being the whole story of Sara Crewe now told for the first time
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
description: Sara Crewe holds onto imagination and kindness when her fortunes suddenly change.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

longDescription: Imagination, friendship and the discovery of a wider world make this a welcoming reading choice across generations. Everyday experiences take on fresh importance through the characters’ perspectives. The original language and historical context are retained in this complete edition.

authorInfo.bio: Frances Eliza Hodgson Burnett was an English-American novelist and playwright. She is best known for the three children's novels Little Lord Fauntleroy (1886), A Little Princess (1905), and The Secret Garden (1911).
